name: Embedded Content: Single Directory Components
description: Bridges Single Directory Components (SDC) to the Embedded Content module so editors can insert any SDC component into a CKEditor 5 text field and map its props and slots.
project_description: Embedded Content: Single Directory Components is a bridge module that exposes every Single Directory Component (SDC) discovered on the site as an insertable Embedded Content plugin. It registers a single EmbeddedContent plugin (id 'sdc') whose deriver enumerates all SDC components from Drupal core's component plugin manager, so each component becomes selectable behind an Embedded Content CKEditor 5 button. Editors map component props and slots through a schema-driven form generated by cl_editorial and schema-forms, and the stored configuration is rendered on output via a '#type: component' render element. Slot values entered as processed text are rendered through the chosen text format. The module ships no routes, permissions, services, or configuration of its own; it inherits all editor gating and rendering from the Embedded Content parent module.
